name: luw
description: AI interior, exterior & landscape design, photoreal renders, image editing, video and 3D — right inside Claude.
long_description: The official Luw.ai extension. Redesign rooms and facades in any style, virtually stage empty rooms, turn sketches and 3D views into photorealistic renders, edit images with a sentence, swap materials, remove backgrounds or furniture, upscale, animate designs into cinematic videos, generate 3D models from photos, and ask ArchiGPT for expert architecture advice. Drop in local images — they are uploaded automatically — and see results right in the chat.

output_dir.title: Save results to (optional)
output_dir.description: Generated images, videos and 3D models are also downloaded into this folder.
